description: Routing switch with two independent sides, each sending one input to one of four outputs and moving on at every trigger

inputs.text: A rising edge moves both sides on to the next output that has a cable in it, each within its own four, wrapping round to the first after the last; it reads high above 1V
The signal routed to the left-hand group of four outputs, passed through at full level to whichever of them the switch is on
The signal routed to the right-hand group of four outputs, passed through at full level to whichever of them the switch is on

outputs.text: Carries the left input while the switch is on this output, and 0V once the switch moves away
Carries the right input while the switch is on this output, and 0V once the switch moves away

notes: each side steps only between outputs that have cables in them, so an output with nothing patched into it is skipped
one trigger jack drives both sides, so they advance together and can only be offset by leaving different outputs unpatched
both sides start on their first output, and Initialize from the module menu puts them back there

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
one channel only

unpatched it reads nothing; no left output is written.
inputs.2:
one channel only

unpatched it reads nothing; no right output is written.
